decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 3 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 43 was fighting for position with Car 22 in Turn 3 when Car 81 was closing in after doing a pit stop. The team informed the driver of Car 43 about blue flags for Car 81. However, after exiting Turn 3, Car 43 forced Car 81 off track on the inside. The Stewards acknowledge that it was very hard for the driver of Car 43 to see Car 81 due to the position of Car 22 in Turn 3 and take this into account in mitigation.
fact: Car 43 forcing Car 81 off of the track between Turns 3 and 4.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 43 Forcing Car 81 Off Track
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
